test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following novels was written by the Indian author Anuradha Roy?

options.text: The Illicit Happiness of Other People

solution:
The correct answer is __**Sleeping on Jupiter**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sleeping on Jupiter was written by the Indian author Anuradha Roy.**

 
 
• Anuradha Roy is an **editor, author, and journalist from India**.
 
• **Rukun Advani**, a publisher, is **Roy's husband**, and they reside in **Ranikhet**.
 
• **Permanent Black**, a publishing company that specialises in academic books and was created in **2000 by Advani and Roy, employs Roy as a designer**.
 
• Roy had previously **collaborated **with **Stree, an independent publisher from India located in Kolkata**.
 
• She left her position as a **Commissioning Editor at Oxford University Press, India, in the year 2000**.
 
• **Novels **by Anuradha Roy
 
 
• An Atlas of Impossible Longing (2008)
 
• The Folded Earth (2011)
 
• **Sleeping on Jupiter (2015)**
 
• All the Lives We Never Lived (2018)
 
• The Earthspinner (2021)
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sleeping on Jupiter**

 
 
• It is her **third book and was released on April 15, 2015, by Hachette India**.
 
• It was **shortlisted for 2015 The Hindu Literary Prize** and **longlisted for the 2015 Man Booker Prize**.
 
• The** 2016 DSC Prize for South Asian Literature** was awarded to it.​​
